title: Bioinformatics analyses associated ANXA1 with head-and-neck cancer progression and chemotherapy resistance
summary: Machine-learning analysis of tumor-expression datasets identified ANXA1-related prognostic and chemotherapy-resistance signals in head-and-neck squamous-cell carcinoma. The paper also reports cell-based experiments; computational associations and candidate-compound analyses do not establish therapeutic efficacy.
ai_technology: LASSO-Cox modeling of tumor datasets with AI-based virtual-cell and molecular-docking analyses.
organization: Southwest Medical University; Affiliated Hospital of Southwest Medical University

evidence.tested: Analyses used TCGA/GEO datasets with validation in GSE65858; cell experiments examined ANXA1-related effects. A candidate compound was computationally proposed.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective bioinformatics plus in-vitro experiments; no clinical treatment efficacy or prospective patient validation established.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO-Cox modeling of tumor datasets with AI-based virtual-cell and molecular-docking analyses.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
